topics.title: The Secret Meaning of the Ticking Clock on Millers Planet
topics.hook: Every single tick of Hans Zimmer's soundtrack on Miller's planet cost Cooper an entire day of his daughter's life.
topics.core_thesis: Hans Zimmer scored the music at 1.25-second ticks, perfectly matching the mathematical relativity of one day on Earth.

topics.title: Doctor Stranges Real Plan for Tony Stark
topics.hook: When Doctor Strange viewed fourteen million futures, he saved Tony Stark for one chilling reason.
topics.core_thesis: Strange didn't bargain for Tony's life to save the universe; he knew Tony had to endure five years of fatherhood so he would finally have something worth sacrificing everything for.

topics.title: Why Steve Rogers Pretended Not to Lift Mjolnir
topics.hook: In Age of Ultron, Captain America didn't fail to lift Mjolnir—he chose not to.
topics.core_thesis: Worthiness is an absolute state. Steve felt the hammer budge and instantly stopped pulling to protect Thor's divine pride.

topics.title: THE CARNEGIE HALL EXECUTION
topics.hook: You thought Fletcher’s Carnegie Hall invitation was redemption, but it was actually a meticulously planned public execution
